title: Quaint Brazilian Fish Skewers
description: A light and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring fresh thyme and grilled to perfection, this flexitarian friendly recipe is perfect for a warm evening, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped thyme to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the tilapia pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated tilapia onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve the skewers on a slate tile vessel, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
